previous_statement: The entrywise amplification of E is iota_2(E)(X,Y)=(X,0), whereas F(0,Y)=(delta Y,0) is nonzero for Y nonzero. Hence F is not iota_2(E). The registered inputs do not define theta as a fixed scalar functional calculus and contain no axiom relating its values in B(A) and B(M_2(A)); therefore they allow the assignments theta(B_{P,P})=E and theta(B_{P_2,P_2})=F, which satisfy all their explicit requirements but violate amplification naturality. This counterinterpretation proves the missing equation cannot be obtained from the allowed inputs and does not invoke node 1.3.
new_statement: The proposed E/F counterinterpretation is invalid under the registered inputs. The registered theta-idempotent-approximation-map fixes theta(U)=(I+sgn(U))/2, while abs-and-sgn-functional-calculus and holomorphic-power-series-functional-calculus fix sgn(U)=U(U^2)^{-1/2} by one scalar norm-convergent power series. Entrywise amplification is a continuous unital algebra homomorphism, so it preserves every partial sum and therefore the limit of this series whenever the registered constructions are defined at both levels. Hence theta(iota_2(U))=iota_2(theta(U)). Applying this to U=B_{P,P} and using B_{P_2,P_2}=iota_2(B_{P,P}) shows that theta(B_{P_2,P_2})=iota_2(theta(B_{P,P})); consequently the summand-mixing F from node 1.4.1.2 cannot be the registered theta(B_{P_2,P_2}). Thus proximity and idempotence of E,F do not make them a model of def-compressed-corner, and the former non-derivability conclusion is withdrawn.
